mechanism: Dual-tower encoder: temporal tower uses recursive multi-scale relative attention (per-head context window shrinks with head id; newest bars first) plus history-stack embeddings of univariate contexts; frequency tower applies Legendre discrete wavelet transform on univariate segments then linear attention φ(Q)·(φ(K)ᵀV) separately on low/high bands; MLP/hyper-agent decoder emits full action sequence in one shot.
data_needed: Multivariate HistoryBars×BarDescr OHLC+indicators; recursive attention history_size stack; wavelet segment size ≥5; Query/Key projections for linear attention.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD M1; train full year 2024; test January 2025; default indicator params.
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS a paired temporal+spectral sequence sensor that separates trend/support structure from high-frequency noise without quadratic full SoftMax over long windows.
quote: One tower specializes in analyzing the temporal structure, identifying trends and patterns, while the second examines the data in the frequency domain.

mechanism: Repurpose each Hidformer tower as trading agents: 4 TS agents + 2 frequency agents, half on raw and half on transposed state; each TS agent has learnable Role MLP → relative cross-attention State-to-Role → S3 learnable segment shuffle → recursive state attention; recursive action attention + multi-scale action-to-state cross-attention; MacroHFT hyper-agent concatenates agent proposals into final trades (volume, SL, TP).
data_needed: Same multimodal M1 state; agent role tensors (10×window_key); action_space triples; stack_size for recursive modules; account/risk features for MacroHFT risk manager.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD M1; 2024 train; January 2025 OOS (29 trades, >60% wins).
why_new_for_mis: Turns dual-tower representations into parallel specialized sensors with role-gated focus and policy-in-context memory—MIS can read which temporal/freq specialist is dominating decisions.
quote: we repurposed the encoder towers as independent agents that generate possible scenarios for upcoming trading operations... six specialized agents are used: four for analyzing multivariate time series and two for processing input data in the frequency domain.

mechanism: ResNeXt bottleneck: 1×1 project to groups → transpose to [Group,Time,Dim] → grouped temporal conv (window×step) with batch-norm/LReLU → transpose back → 1×1 restore; residual path projects mismatched time/channel dims; block sums+normalizes both streams. Cardinality (groups) scales independent pattern extractors.
data_needed: HistoryBars×BarDescr after batch-norm and channel expand (e.g. 128); group_size and groups; conv window=3 step=2 across stacked blocks.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Financial multivariate series; EURUSD M1 in final-part tests.
why_new_for_mis: Cardinality-grouped residual encoder is a reusable shared backbone sensor for MIS multi-head tasks (vol, trend, risk) without separate feature pipelines.
quote: Each grouped convolution in ResNeXT identifies specific patterns in channel groups, which are then aggregated into a unified representation.

mechanism: Multi-task setup: Actor embeds ResNeXt encoder then trade-parameter decoder + MacroHFT risk manager; second model reads Actor latent (pooling layer) and SoftMax-predicts only two direction probabilities (up/down)—flat deliberately omitted as equal-amplitude short swings; live EA trades only when Actor direction matches max probability. Targets from near-perfect future trajectory (argmax/argmin cumulative path).
data_needed: Shared latent after ResNeXt+pool; NActions/3 SoftMax logits; future NForecast bars for teacher targets; account harmonics/timestamp features.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD M1; train 2024; test January 2025 (60 trades, PF 1.52).
why_new_for_mis: Explicit binary directional-regime probability head on a shared encoder—MIS can gate other sensors with P(up) vs P(down) without wasting capacity on flat class.
quote: our model predicts probabilities for only two directions of price movement: upward and downward. The probability of flat (sideways) movement is deliberately not considered

mechanism: Classic Keltner: middle=EMA(maPeriod,PRICE_CLOSE); upper=EMA+atrMultiplier×ATR(atrPeriod); lower=EMA−atrMultiplier×ATR; canvas fills between bands; break outside bands treated as overextension/breakout or reversal cue as volatility adapts.
data_needed: iMA and iATR handles on chart symbol/TF; buffers upper/middle/lower; defaults maPeriod=20 MODE_EMA, atrPeriod=10, atrMultiplier=2.0.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any chart symbol and PERIOD_CURRENT (NULL,0 handles); visual backtest on resized charts.
why_new_for_mis: Concrete ATR-scaled envelope sensor MIS can use as adaptive support/resistance and vol-width regime (band expansion/contraction) independent of neural stacks.
quote: the upper and lower bands are generated by adding and subtracting a multiple of the ATR. This method allows the indicator to adjust to market volatility

mechanism: 2D state-space model: hidden h^(1) carries temporal state and h^(2) cross-variable state; ZOH discretization with Δ1 (time resolution: small→long-term, large→seasonal) and Δ2 (variable-axis context gate); context-dependent B,C,Δ from input projections; OpenCL SSM2D kernel mixes A·H + B·px then C·Δ·H across both axes; forward+backward along feature axis.
data_needed: Multivariate series projections in time and variable contexts; trainable A (full matrices in this impl); SoftPlus Δ; TANH B/C; dual hidden-state buffer.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Multivariate TS benchmarks in paper; trading stack uses EURUSD M1 (final part).
why_new_for_mis: Joint time×feature SSM with explicit Δ knobs is a multi-scale regime/seasonality sensor MIS can tune for trend vs seasonal emphasis and cross-series coupling.
quote: Smaller Δ1 captures long-term progression, while larger Δ1 captures seasonal patterns.... Larger Δ2 values result in smaller context windows, reducing variable interactions, while smaller Δ2 values emphasize inter-variable dependencies.

mechanism: CNeuronChimera runs two parallel 2D-SSMs (second with 2× output width) plus residual projection; convolutional discretization maps high-capacity SSM into the first's subspace; sum+normalize three streams; stack three Chimera modules with SoftPlus nonlinearities while shrinking time length and growing feature width; MTL Actor+direction-probability heads. Empirically locks onto global trend, ignoring M1 noise (avg hold >14h).
data_needed: HistoryBars×BarDescr; Chimera layers BarDescr→16@64, 16→32@32, 16→32@16; probability head on latent.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD M1; train 2024; test January 2025 (27 trades, >70% wins, PF 1.53; shorts-only in test).
why_new_for_mis: Operational multi-scale 2D-SSM stack that behaves as a long-horizon trend-regime sensor even on M1 feeds—useful MIS filter for HTF bias vs microstructure.
quote: The high-frequency model captures long-term patterns, while the low-frequency model focuses on identifying seasonal cycles.... the implemented model is capable of capturing long-term trends while ignoring short-term fluctuations.

mechanism: CNeuronMoT builds four SoftPlus token views per bar—node (1-bar conv), edge (2-bar), subgraph (3-bar), unitary-sequence subgraph (transpose→3-lag per channel→transpose)—concatenates to 4×window and fuses with multi-head Attention Pooling (from R-MAT) instead of HAC clustering.
data_needed: BarDescr×HistoryBars tensor; four conv tokenizers; Attention Pooling over 4 token types per unit.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Financial bars as graph nodes; EURUSD M1 in final-part tests.
why_new_for_mis: Learned mix-of-graph-tokenizations gives MIS multi-view local structure sensors (point, link, clique, per-channel path) with soft selection weights.
quote: we prepare four different types of tokens for each bar and combine their outputs using an Attention Pooling algorithm

mechanism: Pipeline: MoT → S3 token shuffle → NAFS local node smoothing → CNeuronHypridDecoder (ChimeraPlus 2D-SSM with extra temporally-extended third SSM to recover short fluctuations Chimera missed, then Hidformer dual-tower action decoder) → MacroHFT risk manager. Global+local graph-sequence sensing before policy.
data_needed: MoT/S3/NAFS on HistoryBars; ChimeraPlus window/units; Hidformer stack_size=120, heads=4, layers=3; account description for risk block.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD M1; train 2024; test January 2025 (15 trades; avg win/loss >4; higher PF vs Hidformer baseline).
why_new_for_mis: Composable graph-token → local smooth → multi-scale 2D-SSM → dual-tower policy sensor chain for MIS state embedding with explicit short-vs-long temporal pathways.
quote: integrating Chimera and Hidformer within GSM++ has the potential to achieve high dependency encoding accuracy, minimize market noise influence, and enhance the reliability of analytical forecasts.

mechanism: Chaos-inspired SSM: Phase Space Reconstruction by architectural lag (widen window, shorten units); context-dependent Δ,B,C,H from normalized X; diagonal A/D; SoftPlus ΔA evolution; OpenCL parallel scan updates X with neighbor interaction A and normalization H in O(log L); residual D⊙X_norm + C·HS + raw skip. Attractors treated as latent dynamical memory.
data_needed: Normalized multivariate window; window_key latent; DiagMatMult and PScan kernels; SoftPlus on Δ projections.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Theory on chaotic dynamical systems; trading use EURUSD M1 in final part.
why_new_for_mis: Attractor-memory sequence sensor with adaptive time-step and log-time scan—MIS can track latent dynamical state beyond linear AR/Transformer context.
quote: Attraos integrates principles of chaos theory, treating time series as low-dimensional projections of multidimensional chaotic dynamical systems.... multi-resolution dynamic memory module, allowing it to remember and incorporate historical price movement patterns

mechanism: Stack three CNeuronAttraos layers on M1 with PSR lags 5, 15, and 30 bars (5/15/30-minute phase embeddings on same feed), each window_out=256; conv compresses then MTL Actor+direction probability+risk manager. Multi-horizon attractor sensing before decisions.
data_needed: HistoryBars divisible by 5/15/30; BarDescr×lag windows; same MTL probability head as prior articles.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD M1; train 2024 (two-stage batch 1 then 60≈1h); test Jan–Feb 2025 (287 trades, PF 1.15, avg hold >2h).
why_new_for_mis: Explicit multi-resolution phase-space stack on one M1 stream is a ready MIS multi-horizon regime embedding (micro→meso structure) without separate TF feeds.
quote: the first layer of the Attraos architecture... transforms the input into phase space using a 5-step time lag, corresponding to 5 minutes on a 1-minute timeframe.... second layer increases the lag to 15 steps.... third layer increases it to 30 steps.

mechanism: Build N×N currency fair-rate matrix from direct Bid/Ask (invert non-direct); iteratively fill cross-rates via triangles (3 passes, blend 0.7 old + 0.3 triangle); per-pair fair value as average of all intermediate-currency paths; discrepancy % vs market generates SELL/BUY deviation signals; scan triangular cycles for arbitrage profit after Bid/Ask and InpArbitrageThreshold.
data_needed: Live multi-pair quotes for ~8 currencies (EUR,USD,GBP,JPY,...); currency matrix; path averages; arb profit function on three pair indices.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Multi FX majors/crosses on MT5 (EURUSD, USDJPY, EURJPY, EURGBP, GBPUSD, EURCHF, USDCHF, etc.); timer-driven real-time panel.
why_new_for_mis: Cross-sectional fair-value and triangular-inefficiency sensor for MIS liquidity/relative-value regime—complementary to single-symbol sequence models.
quote: It picks up current quotes, builds a matrix of fair rates, and looks for opportunities.... If the real EURJPY exchange rate does not match this calculation, the market has either underestimated or overestimated something.
